presentation.label: DEFORM
presentation.summary: Drive, crush and compression in one, after the Torso S-4: two-band drive, a soft crush and a one-knob compressor, with noise that follows your playing.
presentation.overview: Drive, crush and compression in one, after the Torso S-4: two-band drive, a soft crush and a one-knob compressor, with noise that follows your playing.

controls.name: Drive
controls.doc: params[5]. 0..+36 dB into a soft, slightly uneven clipper; level held about even. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Crush
controls.doc: params[6]. How far the crush goes (Mode picks how); 0 off. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Comp
controls.doc: params[7]. One-knob compressor: threshold and ratio together, level made up. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Tilt
controls.doc: params[8]. 50 flat; up pushes highs into the drive, down pushes lows. Half undone after. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Split
controls.doc: params[9]. Named steps Low, Mid, High: Tilt's crossover, 80 Hz, 650 Hz, 2.5 kHz. Range 0–2.

controls.name: Mode
controls.doc: params[10]. Named steps Bit, Redux, Both: fewer levels, lower sample rate, or both. Range 0–2.

controls.name: Noise
controls.doc: params[11]. Pink noise that follows your playing, before the drive. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Decay
controls.doc: params[12]. How long the noise hangs on after you stop, 20 ms .. 2 s. Range 0–100.

limitations: Hardware untested on the original MS-70CDR with OS 2.10.
This build has startup knob initialization disabled. Check saved settings after recalling a patch.
